subject: Access rollout: SCIM change windows, IP profile tiers & service account ownership
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@triahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access rollout: SCIM change windows, IP profile tiers & service account ownership

Hi Mike —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. To keep momentum on the TriaHealth onboarding, I put together the minimal access rollout matrix we discussed and a few open questions so engineering can finalize the implementation plan. See the attachments (SCIM schema + IP template) and the Drive folder for live copies.

Quick summary / asks:
- IP allowlists: please confirm the CIDR ranges for Staging and Prod. We propose separate profiles (staging: profile-stg, prod: profile-prod) with distinct egress rules.
- SAML/IdP: you mentioned Okta. Can you confirm whether you provide the IdP metadata URL or a certificate bundle?
- SCIM provisioning cadence: do you intend full reprovision nightly or incremental pushes on group changes? We recommend incremental (near-real-time) for user sync, but need to know peak group sizes.
- Service accounts: confirm the owner and requested scopes (token rotate, API create/read for onboarding only). We suggest naming: svc-redwood-<env>-<team>.
- Org policies: any existing RBAC tiers we should map to (admin / app-owner / read-only)?

Planned rollout (high-level):
1) Preflight (this week) — gather IP ranges, IdP metadata, SCIM group mapping.
2) Canary (one app/team) — SCIM delta on staging + Prod IP allowlist; monitor token usage and audit logs.
3) Broad sync — ramp groups, apply org policies, rotate service-account keys after cutover.

Can we book a 30-min follow-up tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm the CIDRs and SCIM approach? If that time doesn't work, propose an alternative.

Attachments: scim-schema-v2.csv (schema sample), ip-allowlist-template.csv (CSV to fill), service-account-naming-guidelines.pdf (naming + minimum scopes).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Onward: please reply with the two CIDR blocks and whether you want incremental SCIM or a nightly full sync.

> SAML/IdP: you mentioned Okta. Can you confirm whether you provide the IdP metadata URL or a certificate bundle?
We will provide an Okta metadata URL (I'll have our IdP team send it).

> SCIM provisioning cadence: do you intend full reprovision nightly or incremental pushes on group changes?
We prefer incremental delta pushes for users and groups. Our largest groups are ~2k users, average group change rate is ~30/day.

> Service accounts: confirm the owner and requested scopes (token rotate, API create/read for onboarding only).
Owner: Alex Chen (alex.chen@triahealth.com). Scopes: limited to SCIM create/update, user read, and audit-log read. No admin-level permissions.

> Org policies: any existing RBAC tiers we should map to (admin / app-owner / read-only)?
We have three tiers: OrgAdmin, AppOwner, User. Map AppOwner -> app-owner, OrgAdmin -> admin.

Also: Procurement has asked for SOC2 evidence before we enable production provisioning. Do you have a short SOC2 summary we can share?

I can do 10am PT tomorrow. Send invite.

Thanks,
Mike Reynolds

Ben / Monica —

Quick technical notes for the call and final plan:
- SCIM: our hosted SCIM supports both full and incremental (PATCH) provisioning. For initial import we recommend an incremental seed (paged pulls) to avoid the rate caps; after that use real-time deltas.
- Rate limits: platform enforces 100 requests/minute for SCIM endpoints on the hosted plan; Dedicated customers can request higher ceilings during handoff (we can escalate). For your groups (~2k) incremental +/- paged imports should comfortably fit.
- IP profiles: we will create two network profiles in your org (profile-stg, profile-prod) and map the service account to profile-prod only when you sign off.
- Service-account naming: agree with svc-redwood-<env>-<team> pattern. Priyom suggests svc-redwood-prod-it for your ops owner (Alex). Keys should be rotated every 90 days; we will provide a rotation webhook.
- Audit logs: we will enable audit-log export to your S3 bucket (you'll need to share write creds or a presigned upload bucket).

I uploaded the SCIM rate-limit FAQ and a short runbook to the Drive folder referenced below. For SOC2: security will share a redacted summary PDF; procurement can get the detailed report under NDA if needed.

Action items for engineering call:
- Mike: confirm S3 bucket or upload method for audit logs.
- Alex: confirm service-account owner email and approve naming.
- Ben: schedule canary window for next Tue (6/29) 02:00–04:00 PT.

Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
